blocks.text: BURBANK, United States — For two months, Mandi Budd has been unable to use her legs — she is paralyzed because of a mosquito bite that nearly took her life. The culprit was West Nile virus, a disease that is spiking in California at levels not seen in more than a decade. In 2026, the state has logged its second-deadliest year on record, with 45 deaths and 617 infections so far. “I’m happy to be on the right side of the dirt,” Budd told AFP with a sigh. “I could have been one of the casualties of this virus, and that’s […]...
